_doc: Stream E. Quests for zone 'test' (The Torbor Fields, around Torborhold), M1. Simple, quick, and each one walks you somewhere new. Format: data/quests/README.md. Step kinds: kill {type, count, where?} · killOne {encounter} (a named rare/elite/boss) · collect {item, count, from: monster type, chance} · visit {vignette | site | point} · talk {npc} · use {vignette, object} · clear {dungeon: 'door'|floor} · deliver {item, npc}. `giver.at` is a settlement name or a vignette id. Rewards: xp and gold are fractions of a level's XP / a kill's gold at the quest level (the server prices them — PLAN §6.5, never fixed numbers here); `item.tier` rolls at YOUR level.

elder_maud.name: Elder Maud Torbor
elder_maud.greeting: You've a sword and two good legs. That makes you the most useful person in Torborhold this week.

reeve_corwin.name: Reeve Corwin Ashby
reeve_corwin.greeting: Half the watch is down with the cough and the other half is scared of a man called Hobb.

bryn_bonesetter.name: Bryn the Bonesetter
bryn_bonesetter.greeting: Sit. No, not there, that's where I keep the leeches.

goody_harl.name: Goody Harl
goody_harl.greeting: If you're here about the pig, you're too late, she ate the last fellow's boots.

old_pell.name: Old Pell
old_pell.greeting: Have you seen my brother Aled? He went to the ford with the flock money.

tamsin_reed.name: Tamsin Reed
tamsin_reed.greeting: Mind the frogs. No, I mean it. MIND the frogs.

quests.name: Wolves at the Fold
quests.offer: Moor hounds have been at the sheep folds every night this week. Thin them out before they get brave enough to come into the lanes.
quests.done: Eight? Good. The shepherds will sleep tonight, and so will I.

quests.name: Tusks in the Turnips
quests.offer: Boars. In my turnips. Again. Five of them, I counted. Make it none.
quests.done: Lovely. Take a turnip. Take two, they've been bitten anyway.

quests.name: The Old Sow
quests.offer: The boars are her litter. Grisel Thornhide — big as a cart, brambles growing out of her back. Find her wallow and finish it.
quests.done: Gods. You actually did it. Here — my husband's knife. He'd want it used on something worth it.

quests.name: The Toll at Fitockpi
quests.group: the captain is an elite: bring a friend
quests.offer: Brigands hold Fitockpi Ford and take a 'toll' off everyone who crosses. Their captain is Hobb Gallowsby. I'd go myself but I'm very busy being in charge.
quests.done: Gallowsby, done? The ford's free? I'll write that down as a joint effort.

quests.name: A Rope for Old Pell
quests.offer: Read the satchel's note, then take it to Old Pell in Wamonhold.

steps.text: Bring the satchel to Old Pell

quests.done: That's his hand. That's his... Thank you. I'd rather know. Take this — he'd not need it now.

quests.name: The Carter's Crates
quests.offer: They'll be back for the rest. Chase off the ones by the cart, then tell the reeve in Torborhold the road isn't safe.

steps.text: Tell Reeve Corwin about the cart

quests.done: Another cart? Right. That settles it. Here's the job I've been meaning to give someone.

quests.name: Frogs Are Not Food
quests.offer: The croakers have eaten my nets, my bait and my nephew's hat. With the nephew still in it, very nearly. Six of them, please.
quests.done: Six! My nephew says thank you. He says it very quietly, he's still upset.

quests.name: The Big One
quests.offer: There's one in the deep reeds the size of a cart. We call it Sallowmaw. It pulls people in with its tongue. Mind that.
quests.done: You smell terrible. You're a hero. Both things are true.

quests.name: Webs in the Barley
quests.offer: There's silk all over Mawehaven's barley field, thick as rope. My gran used to say something lived under the old sinkhole. My gran said a lot of things.

steps.text: Look at the sinkhole in Mawehaven's field
Ask the hedge-witch's garden for answers (read her notes)

quests.done: So it's true. When she comes up, the whole village will need you. The whole field, more like.

quests.name: Grandmother Wakes
quests.offer: When the ground shakes in the barley field, go. Burn her egg sacs. Don't let her sing.
quests.done: Mawehaven owes you. We'll name a field after you. A small one.

quests.name: Bones for Bryn
quests.offer: The hounds below the hill have good clean knucklebones. For splints. Don't make that face, they're dead already.
quests.done: Lovely and clean. Hold out your arm — no, it's a gift, not a procedure.

quests.name: What Lies Below
quests.group: a party of 3-5, or a follower
quests.offer: There is a door in the hill that my grandfather bricked up and somebody has unbricked. Go down. Find out what is at the bottom. Come back, please; I'm running out of heroes.

steps.text: Defeat what waits at the bottom

quests.done: You came back. Both times I've said that this year, I've been surprised. Thank you.
